market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil at $100 and US-Canada trade war create headwinds. AI infrastructure names provide selective upside but broad market faces inflation scare. Expect elevated volatility through Q3 close. Bond volatility at six-year low offers some stability.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle remains multi-year structural trend. India growth and defense spending provide secular tailwinds. Consumer inflation may moderate if oil stabilizes. Trade war resolution via Trump-Xi summit could de-escalate. Private credit tokenization reshapes capital markets structurally.
